method: Retained Ghidra records matched to pinned PE bytes; independent Capstone instruction boundaries and direct normal-flow dominators
findings: No selected index is assigned to the ordinary return; the sole RET is dominated by OR EAX,-1, PUSH EAX and POP EAX around argument cleanup
The final mode CMP has no conditional branch and its flags are overwritten by the following SUB
Signed inclusive scan advances even after candidate comparisons; the upper INT32_MAX case has no finite counter exit after DWORD wrap
Both selected action callers copy the low WORD of EAX to the six-byte request at offset 2
limits: Only these two unmodified disk images and ordinary returning helper ABI; runtime-patched code, abnormal exits, nontermination and stack corruption are outside this proof
Helper side effects, string lifetime and exceptions are not elided; this proof does not authorize skipping the scan
No actual game or original code was executed; existing non-FFFFFFFF lookup test inputs are synthetic captures, not proof of this helper normal return
